parameter.name: Target Torque
parameter.desc: Target Torque (read; FFF8AECA: target torque after the max-torque caps and shaping (0x0BD404 via 0x0BA868); axis of Target Boost and Wastegate Duty Initial/Maximum. Nm = x/80 - 200 (0x116A0C float constants). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2B0/0x2B1 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Torque Request
parameter.desc: Throttle Torque Request (read; FFF8AEDA: throttle-side torque request after the rev/boost torque limits (0x0BD62C), input of the throttle model 0x0C3E34 (AF98 = AF62 + AEDA - 16000). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2B2/0x2B3 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Base Timing
parameter.desc: Base Timing (read; FFF8A645 (s8, MOV.B): selected Base Timing table, rate-limited, plus two corrections (0x0C2C08); 0.5 degree units. Feeds A76A -> A76D -> A74B -> fired timing FFF8A744. Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B4 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Feedback Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Feedback Knock Correction (read; FFF8A79A (s8 <= 0): FBKC integrator (0x0E2BE4); 0x0D9E40 adds x*180>>8 to the 0.5 degree timing sum, so one count = 0.3516 degree. Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B5 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Fine Learning Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Fine Learning Knock Correction (read; FFF8A7A7 (s8): applied FLKC cell value (0x0E73CC), same 0.3516 degree count as FBKC (0x0D9088: x 0x5A / 128). Index 0x199 (J23) carries a coarser copy (x*45>>6 + 90). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B6 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Knock Correction Advance
parameter.desc: Knock Correction Advance (read; FFF8A791 (u8, MOVU.B): KCA = KCA max x DAM curve (0x0E1FD8); same count as FBKC (0x0DB3D4 x 180 >> 8). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B7 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Total Knock Correction
parameter.desc: Total Knock Correction (read; FFF8A77B (s8) = clamp(FBKC A79A + KCA A791 + FLKC A7A7, -128..127), 0 while FFF886AB bit 5 (0x0DFA88). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B8 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Combustion Mode
parameter.desc: Combustion Mode (read; FFF8A85C (u8): 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 after start (0x109B4C); 2 = stratified catalyst heating, 3 = second phase, 4 = normal running (roles inferred, Phase 7 / my research notes). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2B9 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Fuel Rail Pressure
parameter.desc: Fuel Rail Pressure (read; FFF88884 (u16): filtered rail pressure used by the HPFP controller (0x164DB0 actual vs target) and OBD PID 0x23 (2015/2016); 1639.34 counts per MPa (injector-table axes). In 2017/2018 PID 0x23 reads a different variable; the value here is the HPFP controller input in every image. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BA/0x2BB re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Target Fuel Rail Pressure
parameter.desc: Target Fuel Rail Pressure (read; FFF8B9A0 (u16): HPFP target (0x165180: table byte x 150), same unit as the actual. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BC/0x2BD re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Target Boost
parameter.desc: Target Boost (read; FFF8B3B0 (u16): compensated boost target (0x108678: Target Boost(rpm, target torque) x baro/IAT comp), boost-control unit kPa abs = (x + 3404)/256; psi shown against 101.325 kPa (project convention). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2BE/0x2BF re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Boost Control Pressure
parameter.desc: Boost Control Pressure (read; FFF89264 (u16): the boost controller's measured manifold pressure (0x1080E4 error = B3B0 - 89264), same unit as Target Boost. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C0/0x2C1 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Wastegate Duty (Full Resolution)
parameter.desc: Wastegate Duty (Full Resolution) (read; FFF8B3B8 (u16): wastegate duty to timer E channel 11 (0x1088B4), 25600 = 100 %. J10 is the same value / 100.4. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C2/0x2C3 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Wastegate Duty Feedback
parameter.desc: Wastegate Duty Feedback (inferred; FFF8B3AA (s16): boost feedback P + I (0x1080E4), added to the initial duty in 0x108098 (B3A8 = min(B38C x B3B6/32768 + B3AA, B39C)); duty unit 256 per % assumed from B3B8 (inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C4/0x2C5 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Closed Loop Target
parameter.desc: Closed Loop Target (read; FFF8B31E (u16): closed-loop target, equivalence ratio x 32768 (0x0FF8C8; OBD helper 0x171C88 reports 2^30/x). AFR uses stoich 14.7 (assumed). J20 is a coarse byte of the earlier stage B312. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C6/0x2C7 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: A/F Correction (Closed Loop)
parameter.desc: A/F Correction (Closed Loop) (read; FFF8B2F4 (s16): closed-loop correction (0x0FEC3C), factor B2EA = 32768 + B2F4 (0x0FE7F0), limited to +-11469; 32768 = 100 % (inferred from the factor form). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2C8/0x2C9 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: A/F Learning (FFF811D6)
parameter.desc: A/F Learning (FFF811D6) (inferred; FFF811D6 (s8, backup RAM): high byte of the learned value FFF8B2E0 (0x0FC400 -> 0x0FC5B4); feeds the long-term trim chain 0x0FD3E4 -> FFF811D9 -> FFF8A689. one count = 0.39 % (the trim chain multiplies fuel by (A689+128)/256, 0x0D15EC, read; corrected 2026-10-30 from 0.78 %). Logging patch: spare SSM index slot 0x2CA re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Model Air Requirement
parameter.desc: Throttle Model Air Requirement (inferred; FFF8AFA8 (u16): (AF2C - 16000)/(AF64 - 16000) x min(05A118, AF56) x 4 (0x0C37D8), 32768 = 1.0; input of Throttle Required Area 05A148 (meaning as % of full-load air inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CB/0x2CC re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Torque Model Throttle Opening
parameter.desc: Torque Model Throttle Opening (inferred; FFF8AF12 (u16): throttle opening from the Throttle Opening from Target Torque tables (0x0C0010), rate-limited; 65535 = 100 % (inferred from being the input of 059D2C). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CD/0x2CE re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Throttle Required Area
parameter.desc: Throttle Required Area (read; FFF8AFB4 (u16): Throttle Required Area 05A148(rpm, AFA8) (0x0C4D84), input of Throttle Opening 05A0BC in 0x0C326C; 21468 = wide open (physical unit not determined). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2CF/0x2D0 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: ETC Target
parameter.desc: ETC Target (read; FFF8AFBA (u16): ETC target after start add, idle floor and fault caps (0x0C4E5C); % = (x - 10)/460.09. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D1/0x2D2 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Intake Cam Target
parameter.desc: Intake Cam Target (inferred; FFF8B94A (s16): final intake AVCS target of 0x15C250 (clamped +-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree), read by 0x15C880. Units read; crank/cam degrees and sign convention not verified (inferred). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D3/0x2D4 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Exhaust Cam Target
parameter.desc: Exhaust Cam Target (inferred; FFF8B90A (s16): final exhaust AVCS target of 0x16032C, read by 0x1608D8. Same unit and caveat as intake. Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D5/0x2D6 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)

parameter.name: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0)
parameter.desc: Injector Pulse Width (C0B0) (inferred; Low word of FFF8C0B0 (u32): output of the first pulse routine 0x0D2BB8 (latency + quantity x flow comp, x 1.25 = counts of 0.8 us). Logged as the low 16 bits: wraps above 52.4 ms. First injector / first pulse (inferred from the call order). Logging patch: spare SSM index slots 0x2D7/0x2D8 re-pointed at the RAM variable (see my research notes).)
